Which booking site listed the lowest prices for South Padre Island hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 30, 2026 snapshot, at 15 of the 18 South Padre Island hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 5, Agoda at 2, KAYAK.com at 2, trivago DEALS at 2, Booking.com at 1, goseek.com at 1, the hotel's own site at 1 and Wego at 1. These are the South Padre Island rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

Taxes and fees at South Padre Island hotels

At the 13 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 16% ($15 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 13% at Blue Bay Inn and Suites to 18% at Coco Beach Hotel On The Beach. At 5 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
